summary_1line: Hanuman uses the fire on his tail to burn Lanka, leaping across palaces and spreading a catastrophic blaze that terrifies the demons and devastates the city.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman with his flaming tail leaps across the jeweled rooftops of Lanka, the fire spreading from palace to palace under the night sky.
Demon women clutching their infants flee burning balconies while flames engulf the golden mansions of Lanka below.
Hanuman stands atop a high palace roof, his blazing tail like a halo, watching the city of Lanka consumed by towering flames.
